# LeapCRM Integration

Using Hover with LeapCRM

Updated over a week ago

Table of contents

[Connect your Hover account with LeapCRM](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/3088292-leapcrm-integration#h_6784e8a0ef)[Want a demo?](https://help.hover.to/en/articles/3088292-leapcrm-integration#h_15801a2c3a)

The [LeapCRM](https://hub.leaptodigital.com/partner-hover) business productivity platform (formerly known as JobProgress) reimagines teamwork and workflow from the point of view of the home improvement contractor to intuitively track, monitor, and measure your progress.

### LeapCRM's integration with Hover allows you to:

- Create Hover projects from your Leap CRM dashboard, saving you time in the field - Supported measurement types include Capture-Only, Roof Only, and Full exterior.

- Create Hover invites for the homeowner to take photos on your behalf

- Upgrade your Capture-Only or Roof Only projects to Hover's full exterior measurement model and PDF, directly from the Leap CRM dashboard.

- Import measurements directly into LeapCRM and auto-populate quantities to build estimates and proposals

- Import the Hover photos, 3D model link, and measurement file types - including XLSX

- Complete and import multi-structure projects


**Note:** Multi-structure Hover projects are represented in Leap with multiple measurement PDFs - one PDF per structure.

# Connect your Hover account with LeapCRM

* * *

Follow the steps below, or refer to [LeapCRM's instructions](https://help.leaptodigital.com/documentation/hover-2/#sync-jobs-with-hover).

1\. Login to Hover as an admin for your organization.

2\. Navigate to the settings menu from the top right drop down.

3\. Under settings select **Integrations** and click **Connect** under Leap CRM.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/1263099035/10595c34ea7ffd86e0a056d95705/Screenshot+2024-11-22+at+2_30_23%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=7f3dd707f35f243056fd053a21ca177f046ecba982fe6a660c1abb4ba2968b4e&req=dSIhFcl3lIFcXPMW1HO4zWmh%2B%2FvaNkvEdV6wuuiRKb%2Ftm8iONp7Fs4I5lAgg%0A5aXMIQ1o6WJHSF3wj68%3D%0A)

4\. You will then be prompted to authorize the integration. Click **Allow**.

​

5\. You will be redirected to login to LeapCRM.

6\. Once complete, LeapCRM will indicate that you have successfully integrated.

When connected, you can create Hover projects from the LeapCRM for any of the following Hover measurement types:

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/arfbt5q9/2769055908/9b0eebf77bf82426cc743c8f51d8/Screenshot+2026-10-27+at+4_23_50%E2%80%AFPM.png?expires=1794260700&signature=3a380c9e12064bd38a82b11589e0be1be351eff1689cbe5513278b5de8c2fa35&req=dichH8l7mIhfUfMW1HO4zb9mLYUR4bWcP7mkEviz18pWpijtRxXfYEi4ycmw%0AS2HqoOIrOO%2FJmECLevM%3D%0A)
